images.scene: The edge of an old swimming pool seen at water level, close: the worn tiled rim in the foreground and the dark still water beyond, with ONE stainless steel pool ladder entering the water, nothing else, no people. The plain plaster wall behind. Hard low side light, cold feel.

Close-up at the edge of an old swimming pool, seen from the side at water level: ONE bare adult foot, toes just touching the dark still water, the rest of the person out of frame above; worn tiled rim, plain plaster wall behind. Nothing else. Hard low side light, cold feel. No face.
